note: PLATE READ of 8996 (Glossa ordinaria, Epistola ad Romanos), 2026-08-31, two passes. FIRST PASS: Migne PL 114, on-disk scan raw/scans/pl114/patrologiaecurs06saingoog.pdf, PDF page = (column + 11) / 2, calibrated against the printed corner numbers before every read. Eight [sic:] candidates from the chunks 0010-0014 and 0015-0019 stints were carried to the plate this session (cols 495, 497x2, 500, 504x2, 512x2, 517). RESULT: 7 WITHDRAWN as Corpus Corporum's own corruption (Migne prints the word or phrase whole and correct), 1 CONFIRMED as Migne's own printing (0497B revela, left as [sic:] in the English, now plate-licensed). Col 517 required the second witness -- the on-disk archive.org scan clips the left margin at exactly this word, losing 'bant'; Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k54939667 f259 (f = (column+1)/2, calibrated against printed corners 517/518) is clean and prints 'dabant' whole. SECOND PASS (calibration batch for the [sic:]/[var:] backlog, same day): the still-owed cols 0471-0480 (chunks 0000-0004) and the three [var:] candidates at 0509C/0511D/0515D (chunks 0015-0019) plus 0504B (chunks 0010-0014) were read at the same on-disk scan, pages 241-245/257/260/261/263. RESULT: 3 more CORRUPTED (0476C Decem->Ducem, 0480A uod->quod, 0480D excludanturii->excludantur ii fusion), 6 CONFIRMED as Migne's own printing and now fired for real (0476A/475D *sulvat* -- Migne's own misprint for *salvat*, a genuine [sic:]; 0478D Acts 10:35 Deum-for-eum with et operatur justitiam dropped; 0504B John 15:3 verbum quod; 0509C Rom 11:32 in infideli; 0511D Luke 12:49 nisi ardeat; 0515D Ezek 33:12 non proficiet ei si erraverit). NOTE: 0476A's marker is filed under that column heading in cruces.md but the word actually sits at the end of column 0475's D-quarter in the source (TEI marker order confirmed: [0475D] precedes 'sulvat', [0476A] follows it) -- this volume's A-D letters run independently within EACH printed column, not split two-per-column-per-page as assumed in earlier notes on this work; flagged for the cruces record, not corrected retroactively elsewhere.
class: All seven first-pass patches are CORRUPTED (Corpus Corporum broke, fused, or dittographed a word Migne set correctly); the eighth candidate, 0497B revela, is NOT a patch -- Migne himself prints 'revela'. Second pass: three more CORRUPTED (0476C, 0480A, 0480D-fusion); the other six candidates read this pass are NOT patches -- Migne's own printing, confirmed, fired as real markers instead (recorded in cruces.md and data/plate-reads.json, not here).
result: 7 CORRUPTED (first pass): 0495A Ambuans->Ambulans (dropped letter), 0497D meriritum->meritum (dittographic syllable), 0500C eligutur->eligitur (vowel substitution), 0504C lans->laus (dropped letter, confirmed by the plate printing 'laus' at BOTH occurrences on the same line, not just the internal-control second one the translator had already used to suspect the fault),0504D qoud->quod (transposed letters), 0512D nonlicet->non licet (two words fused into one by CC, not a broken sort), 0512D cor tempto->contempto (one word split into two by CC, the exact inverse fault). 0517C daban->dabant is CORRUPTED but by MARGIN CLIPPING in the archive.org copy specifically, not by CC's transcription of that copy -- confirmed on the clean Gallica witness. Not patched: 0497B revela, which is Migne's own printing and stays a [sic:] in the English (no TEI change; our transcription already matches the plate). 3 CORRUPTED (second pass): 0476C Decem->Ducem (substituted letters, the single most misleading column in the work per cruces.md, now resolved), 0480A uod->quod (dropped letter), 0480D excludanturii->excludantur ii (two words fused into one). Not patched, second pass (Migne's own printing, fired as real markers): 0476A/475D sulvat, 0478D, 0504B, 0509C, 0511D, 0515D.

patches.why: Plate p.243 col 476C (corners verified 475/476) prints 'Ducem esse. Caecos et in tenebris existentes dicit gentiles...' clean and whole -- a guide of the blind (Rom 2:19), which the gloss at once expounds. CC substituted 'Decem' for 'Ducem'. The English [n/a -- rendered 'To be ten' per Convention 3 on the corrupted lemma, chunk 0003] is WITHDRAWN; render as 'A guide' with no marker, matching the gloss's own sense.
